name: Search memories
summary: Ask a question in your own words and get back the memories that answer it.
description: Matching is on meaning, not keywords, so the query works best as the question your feature is actually trying to answer rather than the words you expect to find.

params.name: graph_id
params.note: Which graph to search. A key pinned to one graph may omit it.

params.name: query
params.note: Natural language search query.

params.name: limit
params.note: Maximum memories to return. Defaults to 5, and anything above 100 is clamped to 100.

params.name: format
params.note: markdown, the default, is prompt-ready text. json returns structured items instead.

params.name: context_ids
params.note: Narrows: results are restricted to these contexts.

params.name: boost_context_ids
params.note: Widens: also pulls in memories linked to these contexts.

params.name: context_types
params.note: Filter by type. Keys are type names, values are arrays of context names.

params.name: sources
params.note: Filter by provenance tier, for example ["verified", "tool"].

params.name: expand_depth
params.note: How many levels of links to follow. Defaults to 1.

returns: A rendered string by default. With `format: "json"` you get `items` instead of `memories`.

name: Send an observation
summary: Propose a memory instead of writing one.
description: An observation is not a write with a flag on it. What comes back is an id, not a memory: the engine distils a statement from the payload and a person approves or rejects it before anything is stored.

params.name: graph_id
params.note: Which graph the finding would be filed in.

params.name: source
params.note: Where this came from. `derived` is refused: the engine never re-observes its own output.

params.name: payload
params.note: The raw observation, stored verbatim. Capped at 64KB; whole documents belong to ingest.

params.name: stream
params.note: A name that keeps concurrent workflows apart. Capped at 256 bytes.

params.name: observed_at
params.note: When the observed thing happened, in unix seconds. No earlier than 2020, no more than a day ahead.

returns: `observation_id`, with a 202. Nothing is stored yet.
